data_note: This file contains two types of events: (1) VAR-reviewed decisions (type: var_review) — goals disallowed, penalties, card upgrades, mistaken identity; (2) Direct red cards (type: red_card, var_reviewed: false) — shown by referee without VAR. Yellow cards and other non-VAR incidents are excluded.

var_decision.note: Harry Souttar (Australia) misses the penalty! His poor effort goes well over the crossbar.
GOAL! Mahmoud Saber (Egypt) sends the penalty kick into the left of the net.
GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Jackson Irvine (Australia) into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Oufa Shobeir no chance!
Rami Rabia (Egypt) steps up to take the penalty and leaves the keeper helpless with a low shot inside the left post.
Goal! Awer Mabil (Australia) sends the keeper the wrong way and scores into the bottom left corner.
Mohamed Salah (Egypt) smartly converts the penalty. He strikes the ball into the middle of the goal, leaving the goalkeeper stranded.
Lucas Herrington (Australia) misses the penalty as he smashes the ball against the crossbar!
Goal! Hossam Abdelmaguid (Egypt) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Mathew Ryan into left side of the goal.
